ValidationRule.description: Consignee Phone Number should be of 10 digits and can only contain numbers.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Custom_Validation_Exception_Setting__c.Bypass_Validation_Rules__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Consignee_Phone__c)), OR( LEN( Consignee_Phone__c ) != 10, NOT(REGEX(Consignee_Phone__c , "[0-9 ]+")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Consignee Phone Number should be of 10 digits and can only contain numbers.
